name: Floor Scrubber Brush
definition: A floor-contact cleaning element inside a scrubber head; brush type, diameter or width, drive interface, bristle or pad grade, speed, contact force and machine-head identity must be approved together.
includedScope: Disc and cylindrical brushes for scrubber-dryers
Pad drivers and orbital head boundaries
Working width, material, drive and machine-family checks
excludedScope: Chemical suitability claims without floor and detergent evidence
primaryApplications: Disc, cylindrical and orbital cleaning heads
headline: Brush architecture, floor task and exact scrub head must be approved as one cleaning system.
description: This profile compares official disc, cylindrical and orbital scrub-head evidence and turns it into practical brush, pad, wear and machine-fit checks.
metaDescription: Floor scrubber brush types, disc and cylindrical systems, pad grades, working width, wear limits and machine compatibility checks.
disclaimer: Physical resemblance, matching wattage, matching voltage, a generic family name or a seller claim does not establish compatibility. Verify the current manufacturer part number and revision, machine model and serial scope, mechanical, electrical and fluid interfaces, rated operating envelope, protection requirements and approved service documentation.
